start_here: Say to your AI: "Pour the example reply templates from workflow:answer-comments-and-messages into my saved-replies list." It reads your list's fields, matches them to the kit's and hands you the one write that adds the examples.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads a kit's list and the person's list it is given, and answers a write for theirs.
instructions: 1. Pick the kit list to pour: an item's kit.lists entry (tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json for a workflow, a tool row's kit for a tool).
2. Read your own list that does the same job with run_resource_operation @own-records records:read { id: "list:<yours>" }: its fields and row type go in into; the ids of its rows go in already_there.
3. Run this tool. When it says poured, send its write with run_resource_operation; when it says the match is under 80%, map the fields it names in field_map or make the kit's own list instead.

worked_examples.title: Two reply templates poured into a saved-replies list
worked_examples.ask: Put the example reply templates into my saved replies list.
worked_examples.given: A saved-replies list with the fields keywords, body and owner.
worked_examples.hands_back: poured true, coverage 1 (match_words to keywords and text to body, each by a name it goes by), and a records:write at @own-records adding record:saved-reply:kit-price and record:saved-reply:kit-hours.
